summary:
This change adds comprehensive, rigorously validated local-attested v2 protocol contract support—including requests, authorization, receipts, status, and self-reported usage—for review lanes, with carefully enforced privacy boundaries, newly extended fixtures, and thorough corresponding tests.

<!-- award -->
🛡️ GATE GUARDIAN 🛡️
"No bad data shall pass your vigilant defense. Users may enter
the most bizarre combinations, but your code stands firm, like a sentinel at the gates
of the data city. 'You shall not pass!' it speaks to invalid format."
